reviews.text:
There are truly no words to express how amazing this team is. Our sweet 3-year-old doodle swallowed a sewing needle—yes, it was just as traumatizing and terrifying as it sounds. He has never chewed on anything he shouldn’t, and he is the absolute best boy, so this was the LAST thing we ever thought could be wrong with him.

Dr. Manrique and her incredible team quickly figured out what was happening and, within minutes, were able to safely remove the needle. Their quick thinking, expertise, and compassion made all the difference. If it weren’t for this amazing team, we wouldn’t be able to go home with our boy and continue giving him all the love he deserves every day.

We are beyond grateful for the care they gave him and look forward to being clients for many, many years to come. We truly can’t thank this team enough! ❤️
Quick, easy appointment with no surprises. We think Dr. Ojala is a great veterinarian.
Dr. Seng and the whole team have taken great care of Lola the past couple of years. Genuine people, detailed/thoughtful care, and reasonable prices. Can't recommend them enough!

We have been going to South Loop Animal Hospital for several years and have been very happy. We have so much trust in our vet and even though we moved to a different neighbhorhood we still come back here.

Dr Sanchez, Mistar, and Saucedo have all been very helpful in helping our baby boy, Xiao Hei, navigate a treatment plan. I'm looking forward to scheduling much needed treatment and surgey soon to try to get him even better.

When Eddie our pupp was  showing symptoms of pain, the Vets at the South Loop Animal Hospital saw him right away.  Everyone provided the highest level of care and concern.  The cost of their services was very reasonable.
Always have a good experience.
Dr Manrique see's both our mini golden doodle and giant schnauzer, she helps us take really good care of our pets.
Dr. Ojala and the office staff were super responsive to my concerns and took great care of my Pumpkin.
I have always had great care and support from the family at Southloop.  Love them

“Fear free clinic” — 2 parking spots — expect a minimum of $100 - $150 per visit before any conversation. Vaccinations are costly. Booking online is basically sending them an email to tag you back.

Owner with a new puppy doing our initial wellness checks.
Office is clean and has a Kitty corner so that way if you have a cat, you can sit away from the dogs. The receptionist are amazing. Very sweet kind and always happy to welcome you.
I asked on my first visit if we could also do some bloodwork since she was new to me. They denied the opportunity because ‘ puppies don’t show need of it’ — im raising a working dog I need to be fully aware of a lot of things.

I do not appreciate my technician. Other than the fact that every visit they try and offer me a month-long preventative. And right now my visits are weekly. He has done this to me three times.
Results are sent via email. (That’s ok) the opportunity to ask question from the doctor require a follow up set up appointment — or google. And if you have any follow up results because you had to come back, don’t expect those timely.

my last fecal tests were not even put into the system for request. But the doctor is the one who told me to bring it in gave me medicine and everything.

3 rounds of meds, Three fecal samples later, about two months behind on vaccinations, and several sales attempts to move to science diet. My doctor tells me shes never dealt with persistent giardia.

It wasn’t until internet diving that I learned just how DEEP I need to clean with this.
🙃 if she would’ve told me something like this from the beginning, I could’ve just saved my time.
they care so much, and treat my puppy with so much care

The staff at South Loop Animal Hospital clearly love what they do, and love seeing every pet walk in the door. It can be loud/anxiety-inducing for our anxious cat (I love dogs and I know they can get loud, not the staff's fault), and the service prices can be high, but we get a superb quality of care. Thank you!

I have a dog with a lot of complex health issues.  The vets and staff at South Loop Animal Hospital have always been extraordinary. They listen well, explain well, and truly collaborate on my dog's care.  They do whatever they can to make everything convenient and timely as well.  I have been going there for years now, and their care has always been excellent.
Excellent care received with Dr. Manrique. Very personable. Listened. Comprehensive and clear guidance
The team at South Loop Animal Hospital are wonderful! They are experienced, kind, and practical in providing excellent care to their patients. I highly recommend!

We loved our first visit to South Loop Animal Hospital! Everyone was kind, patient, and knowledgeable. The Dr answered all of my questions as a first time puppy Mom, and you can tell that everyone there genuinely cares about your pet! It is clean, has flexible hours, and was a breeze to collaborate with for my pet insurance. So grateful to have SLAH in the neighborhood!

We prefer to take our kitty to veterinary practices specializing in cats, but the treatment he receives at South Loop Animal Hospital is quite good. The hospital is beautiful and clean, the team is very caring, and Dr. Seng is fantastic!

Kind caring compassionate staff, technicians, and veterinarians who have provided years of excellent care for our senior dogs. A beautiful little park outside their front doors nestled between buildings makes a calming respite after a sad and stressful time.
Trustworthy veterinarians, friendly staff, great hours, and parking. Literally, everything you could want.

Great location. Drs truly care. quick diagnosis, and follow-up.
All in all, great.

It's a charming little place hidden away amid taller and newer buildings, but the two parking spaces are reserved and I've never had an issue parking. The atmosphere is friendly and calming enough for our two nervous kitties.
We’ve been bringing our dog Potato here since he was a puppy. The staff is amazing and have always taken great care of Potato.
We had our first patient visit and the team was very nice and welcoming to us and our dog.

We have been taking our dog to South Loop Animal Hospital for almost 5 years now, and I have consistently been impressed with the care, compassion, and service we have received from every member of the team. I cannot recommend them enough.
I JUST referred this practice to a friend the other day. We’ve been trusting SLAH with our fur babies for YEARS. Through good times and sad they’ve been a wonderful support to us.

The staff and vets here are incredible! They're super sweet, they take the time to get to know your pet and completely understand that they're your fur baby :-) Even towards the end of your pets life they're fiercely loyal. Their team of vets is highly cooperative so even if your particular vet isn't available, if needed you can easily work with one of the others, they're all great!

Everyone was so welcoming and attentive. Dr. Mistar answered all my questions, gave  me very helpful advice, and was great with my energetic and strong-willed Maltipoo. I feel very confident that I found the right vet for him.

I’ve been taking my two cats here for six months and have been very pleased with the friendly, professional, and compassionate care they provide. The dog I just rescued two months ago seems to agree because she tries to go in every day when we walk by even though she’s only been there twice so far. Unfortunately, the cats did not give the same ringing endorsement.

I love South Loop Animal Hospital. The staff is incredibly professional, and Dr. Sanchez, who cares for my dog Diesel, is nothing short of family. I trust South Loop with all of my pet care needs. If you give them a try, I’m confident you’ll feel the same way.
Every single SLAH employee offers their pet owners with time, space and support.  Reception, techs, customer service and the doctors all are amazing!

I feel so lucky to have found this place. The staff is just amazing. I have a "problem child" cat who gets stressed out at the vet and they are so patient with him. He needed diagnostics and they have gone out of their way to make it as stress-free as possible for him.

The doctors are very knowledgeable, and take time to explain things clearly and talk through the options. I never feel judged or rushed. Highly recommend!

I arrive with my sick puppy at 9:30 And waited until 1030 and still have not been seen by the vet. I told the receptionist I was stepping away to allow my puppy to pee and to extend the parking after 5 min  walk back in they told me that they canceled my appointment. Leaving my sick puppy without appointed help. No convenient parking either

My 4-year old dog has been a patient at SLAH since he was around 6 months old. I can say without any hesitation that they provide an excellent standard of care. Everyone in the office knows my dog when he walks in the door and they do everything they can to make him comfortable. Beyond the in-office care, I know that I am going to receive a personal follow up call after every visit - just to check on my dog's progress. This is really a veterinary practice with caring and knowledgeable professionals.

I can't say enough great things about South Loop Animal Hospital. From the moment we walked in, the staff was warm and welcoming, you could tell they genuinely love animals. The facility is spotless and well-organized, which immediately puts you at ease.
The doctor was incredibly knowledgeable and took the time to actually explain everything. No rushing, no brushing off questions. Just thorough, thoughtful care. My cat is not that easy to work with as he gets very anxious at the vet, But Dr. Saucedo was really good with him & was able to get everything done.

My cat was in great hands. That's all that matters. Highly recommend to anyone in the South Loop looking for a vet they can trust!

We had a fantastic first experience at SLAH! The welcoming atmosphere made a huge difference for us and our dachshund. Dr. Seng was wonderful. She clearly explained her process and ensured all of our concerns were addressed. Our dog was noticeably more comfortable here than other clinics, which speaks volumes about the team's approach. We’re glad we found this team at SLAH!

Truly the best vet clinic I have ever been to (and I’ve worked at vet clinics!) — so sad that we moved to the west coast because the care    at South Loop is amazing. Every member of the staff is wonderful and Dr. Sanchez, Dr. Ujiki, and Dr. Manrique are really exceptional vets. We feel so lucky to have had our pets cared for by the whole team.

I’ve been bringing my (now super senior) cocker spaniel to see Dr Mistar for nearly a decade. She is an amazing vet, and hands down the best vet I’ve worked with in the Chicago area. She has helped us navigate numerous complex health issues, especially in recent years, and always treats us with kindness and provides thoughtful treatment options that make the most sense for balancing my dog’s age and unique needs. I cannot recommend Dr Mistar and SLAH more highly!
I have used South Loop Animal Hospital for ten years, and I absolutely trust them. They have gone above and beyond for my fur babies!

I wholeheartedly recommend SLAH.Throughout the years, my pets have benefited from exceptional care. Dr.
Sanchez and his team exhibit extensive knowledge,
professionalism, and a genuine commitment to client well-being. The office staff maintains a professional and welcoming demeanor. My 19-year-old dog's continued health is a direct result of their dedication. SLAH stands out as the top veterinary office in Chicago.

I can honestly say I have been with these wonderful people since day 1 and still have no plans to ever go anywhere else! I don't usually do reviews I'm just not that person but this place deserves one great staff from front to back,the people you can tell just care,and the cost is better than any place I've ever herd of I will stay with them until I no longer have animals..,.

Very responsive! We needed to establish care and filled out an application online. Within minutes, we got a call and set a date within the next week to visit. Very friendly vet and staff when we arrived for our appointment!

I have been taking my cats here for many years and always receive the best service. They’re so friendly, caring and patient. When my older cat had a lot of health issues they were so accommodating with squeezing him into appointments as needed and tried to minimize costs where they could. My older cat has since passed but SLAH team sent flowers / a card signed by the staff when it happened and it was such a sweet sentiment and made me realize how genuine they are. I have since adopted another cat who I make sure gets her care from the SLAH team, specifically Dr Ojala (she’s the best!) - however everyone is wonderful here! From front desk staff, to vet techs to drs. Highly recommend!
Easy to schedule appointments, pleasant & professional staff, thorough yet practical medical analysis and treatment recommendations.

Absolutely wonderful experience from start to finish! Jada made our scheduling super easy, and the entire team once we arrived were incredibly kind and helpful! So thankful to have such a supportive team to take care of our pets. Could not recommend more!
I always tell my friends about South Loop Animal Clinic.
I highly recommend South Loop Animal Hospital. The provided great care for my American Bulldog Mix. They are responsive and friendly. Thank you SLAH!

South Loop Animal Hospital in Chicago is truly the best of the best. Every visit reminds me why I trust them so wholeheartedly with my cats. From the moment we walk through the door, the entire team shows genuine warmth, professionalism, and compassion. They don’t just “treat” my cats — they care for them like family.

The veterinarians are incredibly knowledgeable and take the time to explain everything clearly, never rushing through appointments. The techs and front desk staff are equally amazing — patient, kind, and always ready with a reassuring word or helpful tip. What I love most is how attentive they are to the little details. They make sure my cats feel safe and comfortable, and they always follow up after visits to ensure everything is going well.

Finding a vet like this is rare. South Loop Animal Hospital consistently goes above and beyond, and I’m so grateful to have a place where my cats receive such fabulous, top-tier care. If you’re looking for a veterinary clinic that is compassionate, thorough, and truly exceptional, look no further — this is the place.

Highly, highly recommended! 🐾💛

chicago pet owners, can’t RECOMMEND this location enough ! starting with the warm welcome from two friendly folks at reception to the person completing intake, we experienced a team that genuinely loves pets and ensures you and your fur baby receive high quality care. my pup couldn’t have loved dr. mistar more (even after the vaccines!) as her approach is empathetic and conscious of the dog’s comfort. so happy to have established care here!

From the time I walked in, I had a pleasant experience.  I  needed a new vet in the area, and couldn't be happier with my choice! My 12 yo dog, Billie, needed to be seen, and was able get in within a few days.  This was an initial visit to establish care, and Dr. Amy Ujiki was extremely thorough in her exam of Billie, addressed my concerns, and proposed a plan of care. She has a phenomenal bedside manner, and never felt rushed. Absolutely a 10! I would be remiss if I didn't mention Leticia (sp?) our vet tech who was did a wonderful job as well.  I highly recommend South Loop Animal Hospital, as the care we received was truly "white glove service".

The vet doctor here are so kind and helping. Dr.Saucedo is also bilingual so its a plus when my father has to take my pup to get his shots while im busy at work. This was the clinic that told me about my previous dogs heart murmur which all of the previous clinics I visited before failed to mention to me.

Dr. Sanchez and the team made our first puppy wellness exam with Enzo low stress and a truly positive experience. They never made us feel rushed, and Dr. Sanchez answered all our questions with patience and expertise. They let us conduct Enzo's first exam on the floor of the exam room, offer his dog food, and treated him gently with care. Stephanie the veterinary technician is fantastic, too!
I've been apart of the South Loop Family over 10yrs. Always loving, attentive and supportive!! Dr. Sanchez will always be my go to person, but all of the vetenarian's are top tier!!!
They are great. We have seen almost all the vets on staff. We have a large dog and they are so kind! It is pricey but also so is every vet!

My dog was barely able to finish his walk one day due to sudden worsening of hip arthritis. I found South Loop Animal Hospital had excellent reviews and I was in the market to find a new Veterinary clinic/hospital.
I got in sooner than expected for a new client, and we had the best experience we have ever had. Firstly, this office is immaculate and odor free. The veterinary assistant was thorough in our onboarding to their system. The Veterinarian was also thorough, detailed in explanation of our options and sent me a very detailed summary of care options for my dog after our visit.
I highly value and respect the professional and friendly culture there at SLAH. We thank you so much!!

Have been coming here for years with my two dogs. Called and asked for a dental estimate. They told they have to see my new dog first. That’s a money grab to pay an exam fee ect. No  vet has ever told me that have to see my dog first for dental estimate. It’s an estimate after all. Of course if the estimate is reasonable I don’t mind paying an exam fee to get established.
Won’t be coming back here anytime soon money hungry.

I brought my cat in regarding dilated pupils, weight loss, anxiety and allergies.  The doctor gave me 3 prescriptions to try.  All of them worked immediately.  My cat is no longer finicky, she has been completing her meals with the probiotics added. She is doing very well.  I was going to wait a few days but im so glad I came.

We love it here. Everyone is so nice and friendly. SLAH has a great team of responsive staff members. If I have a concern with my pet, I know SLAH if just a phone call or text away. They have a clean facility and someone is always there to welcome us when we walk in. If we need a last minute appointment, they accommodate us as best as they can and keep us in the loop for any openings. I always feel confident bringing my pet here.
Excellent service. Personal; didn’t feel like a corporate environment, felt like a small group of caring individuals, including vet who listened, was genuine and empathetic, and clearly competent.

Had my cat Sneaker put to sleep this morning by Dr. Karnia at SLAH. I would not recommend this facility. Take your pet to a veterinarian that cares about you and your pet. We found out my cat had lymphoma in his paw based on a biopsy completed by another vet. We took him to SLAH for a second opinion. He saw Dr. Karnia and she told us he had an infection and ran blood tests that further confirmed his lymphoma. My issue with her is that she knew the infection in his foot was being caused by the lymphoma, but when she was first explained it she made it seem like the infection was being caused by something else. So everything she said or recommended had me coming back to the clinic to pay for useless blood tests and antibiotic injections that were only a temporary fix. I paid $577 for his first visit. And the whole time Dr. Karnia should have known how pointless that was since lymphoma is one of the worse cancers a cat can have. Dr. Karnia also avoids conflict. Every time I asked her a question she never directly answered. She only told the truth about my cat and his cancer and the severity of it when I told her I wanted to have him put to sleep. When she did the first blood test and explained how his red and white blood cells were doing and after she said we can come back and she wanted his blood drawn a second time time to see how things were going. We can back a second and scheduled with another doctor but requested Dr. Karnia to follow up. At the second visit with the vet she had his blood drawn but would not give a second antibiotic injection for the infection because she said there were no open wounds. Dr. Karnia called me later explaining the results saying he did need a second injection because based on the blood work is body was still fighting the infection. She also recommended we get him an ultrasound to see what stage his lymphoma was and to see if it had spread. Now my cat was an older cat and I felt that with the type of cancer he had and his age that she kept suggesting possible next steps treatment or seeing an oncologist. After taking Sneaker to the second vet at SLAH on Tuesday Sneaker started declining fast and we could tell he was in pain. To me Dr. Karnia wanted to keep pushing the ultrasound and further next steps without taking into account his age and the severity of his cancer that she initially did not explain was so severe. However yesterday I scheduled to have him euthanized this morning. She called me yesterday and agreed that would be a good decision at this point but not once did she ever mention that we should put him to sleep AS AN OPTION . She was all about the money!!!!! She wanted to see what she could get from me yet she did not consider my cat’s quality of life until I mentioned euthanizing him! If I did not mention euthanizing him she was going to be fine with proceeding with the ultrasound and whatever else she recommended. And when Dr. Karnia speaks she does a lot of talking without saying nothing! Not once did she take responsibility for the suffering my cat endured. She knew once she got the biopsy results from the previous veterinarian that my cat’s cancer was advanced. She was strictly all about the money and she never really answers your questions directly. She discusses everything but what you asked her. She speaks empty words like a used car salesman. PLEASE DO NOT TAKE YOUR PETS TO SLAH !!!!!!!We also called asking how much to euthanize him and the receptionist said something like $104 since he is a patient and like $200 something if he was not a patient. I paid $184. So they are not always clear and honest about the prices. My mother even asked the blonde bob haired tech a question regarding this and she was legit ignoring her. She did not say anything until I said excuse me. In addition there are a lot of young veterinarians at this clinic. I recommend finding a veterinarian that is at least over 40 with more experience. The techs are extremely young as well. And please find a veterinarian that cares about you and your pet!!!!

We’ve been bringing our pup Arya to South Loop Animal Hospital at their East Side location, since she was just a tiny puppy in 2021, and we truly couldn’t ask for a better team. Every doctor and receptionist we’ve encountered has been kind, professional, and clearly passionate about animals.

A special shoutout to Calli — she always remembers us, even though we’ve become snowbirds splitting our time between Florida and Chicago. It means so much to feel that personal connection and genuine care every time we walk through the door.

South Loop Animal Hospital is a place where your pet is treated like family. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a vet team they can truly trust!

I am so thankful for everyone at SLAH. I've been taking my dog there for a few years now and everyone I've worked with has been kind, helpful, and knowledgeable. Whenever I have a question I am able to get a hold of someone or ensure my message gets to the right person. My pup can be super nervous and they always do their best to put him (and me) at ease. I would highly recommend them to any pet parent!

South Loop Animal Hospital are a perfect example of what I hope all veterinarian practices can be. The entire staff, from the front desk answer my phone calls and responding to my emails, to the techs and doctors (especially Dr. Slezak!) taking great care of us during our visits, my family and I are eternally grateful for how they treated our pets. One of our dogs was very reactive to vet visits but the team always was patient and willing to help us figuring out the best strategy. I highly recommend this veterinarian practice for anyone in not just the South Loop neighborhood but the general Chicago area too!
We love South Loop Animal Hospital. Our dog is afraid of everything and the vets manage to keep him calm. also very easy to work with in terms of appointments and billing.

First visit with my new pup, Hades and we were very happy! Great location, space and staff. We actually experienced a serious accident before being official patients but the staff referred us to a nearby ER Vet that saved the day. Kudos!

Dr. Seng and Dr. Mistar always take great care of my dogs and always make me feel extremely comfortable. I want to give Cody a special shout out for helping with my very sick but also spicy small dog. Everyone was patient, kind, and I am truly happy to have access to people who care so much.
I like that the vet assistant allows you to come back in office with your pet.  Nothing is hidden.

There are no words for Dr. Sanchez. He is simply the best. Professional, knowledgeable, thorough, and compassionate. We are so thankful for SLAH! They’ve taken such good care of our cat throughout the years.

Our relationship with South Loop Animal Hospital has been going  on for over ten years.  This is our fourth and fifth senior rescues we have taken to be treated  there.  This past week our little Yorkie was having problems with her eyes to the point of her crying in pain.  Called South Loop in the morning and was in there within two hours.  The expediency is due to the fact she has cataract and doesn't get worst. From the moment we walked in until we left everyone we dealt with had one concern to help our little princess.  Dr. Sanchez examined her taking care to make sure there was nothing new.  The problem was identified as irritation that could easily be dealt with.  I have seen changes in the staff at South Loop but never anyone there that was not of the highest caliber.  The doctors there have performed  numerous surgeries on our dogs always with the best of results.  They have no problem with sending us to specialist if needed.   Next month surgery is scheduled for our little Chihuahua.  Not even thinkingof taking him anywhere else.

What an excellent experience! The team at SLAH recently cleaned my senior dog's teeth, and everyone was incredibly caring and professional. I appreciate the level of information they conveyed--that he was doing well under sedation, before/after pics and a detailed analysis of his tooth health--and the attention they paid to every detail. I have always been satisfied with the care my dog has received at SLAH and their sister location, East Side Veterinary, and this experience really put me over the top. Thank you!
South Loop Animal Hospital is the BEST! They really care about your animals and provide the best medical services. They are just AMAZING!
Absolutely love this place and so do my dogs!  There is no other team that I trust my family with!

I absolutely love the doctors and staff here! They're very kind and helpful whenever I have inquiries about anything, and have helped my precious kitty baby so much. I recommend everyone to come here for vet services because everyone does their job splendidly. Thank you so much!
Dr Ojala and the entire staff couldn’t be more attentive to Tilly and myself. I come all the way from Bartlett because I want only the best for my puppy.
Outstanding cat care, have been going for 10 years to Dr Ojalá and won’t go anywhere else.

I am deeply grateful for the care my cat and late dog received at South Loop Animal Care. Dr. Manrique, Dr. Ojala, the technicians, and the front desk staff have all been exceptionally compassionate and dedicated, providing excellent care and support. This is a place where I can trust that I’ll be contacted if necessary, rather than having to follow up on medications or other matters. I also love the new look of the facility—it’s a wonderful change!

We've been taking our dogs to South Loop Animal Hospital for a couple years and I highly recommend them. Everyone there is so friendly and knowledgeable, they take their time explaining what's happening with your pet and really seem to care. We see Dr Sanchez, he's the best, very thorough and kind. We used to see another vet who retired and she recommended him, so glad she did.

I have been taking my dogs since they first opened. So convenient and Dr. Manriquez (one of the original founders of the S Michigan Ave location) is great. I just wish the costs of tests, etc., were a bit more affordable, but the service itself is fantastic. Highly recommended.

I lucked up and called South Loop because my cat had an abscess. They had a same day opening, which is not usual (2wks for new clients is more common). There were 2 vets I ultimately worked with - Dr. Ojala then Dr. Skezak. Both were very compassionate and professional with her and me. The first appt available for the tooth extraction was 1.5 wks away, but Dr. Ojala said she'd see if things could be switched around. I don't know if it was that or a cancelation, but they called me 3 days later to get us in 5 days sooner than scheduled!

After I dropped her off they called to say the machine for the surgery wasn't working properly. Rather than rescheduling, they asked if they could take her to East Side Animal Clinic for the procedure. Minor inconvenience but so not an issue...I was so appreciative that they had a plan that meant her surgery could still happen. I knew she was in pain.

The next day, Dr. Slezak called me just to check in - see if she was eating, if she was draining, how she was doing. I don't think a vet has ever done that before. I was so touched.

Glad I found this place! Already referred them to a friend.
